label: Distinct-step dependence for being has no finite cycle
paraphrase: Structural property of the dependence relation D on beings: no finite chain of D-edges, each between two distinct beings, returns to its starting being. It implies STMT-DISTINCT-BEINGS-NOT-MUTUALLY-DEPENDENT, which excludes only two-step cycles, and also excludes longer cycles such as a three-cycle of distinct beings (that strictness is elementary and not separately certified). It says nothing about infinite descent or well-foundedness.
